question: You are a logistics coordinator for an international medical response team. A remote Arctic research base radioed in a request for an urgent shipment of a new vaccine after an outbreak. There are three delivery routes: A (Mountain Pass), B (Frozen Lake), and C (Old Supply Road). Each route has previously been used for deliveries, but recent conditions may have changed their safety. A strict delivery deadline means only one route can be chosen. The goal is for the group to decide together which route ensures the vaccine reaches the base safely and on time.
